zh.title: 烏克蘭稱俄軍基地六架Su-34戰機受損
zh.summary: 烏克蘭總參謀部稱六架Su-34受損，損害程度尚未獲獨立確認
body: 烏克蘭海軍表示，該部隊在10月15日凌晨前後使用「Neptune」海岸飛彈系統，攻擊位於俄羅斯沃羅涅日州的Borisoglebsk軍事空軍基地。海軍稱有六架Su-34M戰鬥轟炸機遭摧毀。
烏克蘭武裝部隊總參謀部其後表示，已確認基地內六架Su-34多用途戰鬥轟炸機受到不同程度損害。AeroTime報導指出，損害程度尚未獲獨立確認；海軍所稱六架飛機全數遭摧毀，並未獲總參謀部的說法確認。

en.title: Ukraine says six Su-34 bombers damaged at Russian air base
en.summary: Ukraine’s General Staff says six Su-34s were damaged; extent remains unverified.
body: Ukraine’s Navy said it used its Neptune coastal missile system to strike Borisoglebsk military air base in Russia’s Voronezh region overnight into October 15, 2026. The Navy claimed that six Su-34M fighter-bombers were destroyed.

In a later statement, the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine said it had confirmed that six Su-34 multirole fighter-bombers sustained damage of varying degrees at the base. The extent of the damage has not been independently established. The General Staff’s statement did not confirm the Navy’s claim that all six aircraft were destroyed.

zh.title: 巴西航空工業與Portugália Airlines簽署E-Jet機隊支援協議
zh.summary: 巴西航空工業簽約支援Portugália Airlines的19架E-Jet區域機隊
body: 巴西航空工業已與TAP旗下Portugália Airlines簽署Component Pool Program協議，為該航空公司的19架區域型E-Jet提供支援。協議涵蓋12架E-190及7架E-195。巴西航空工業表示，計畫涵蓋E-Jet多個系統、逾300項飛機零組件，並包括零組件交換服務，以及維修與大修方案。
Portugália Airlines董事總經理Mário Lobato de Faria於2026年10月15日表示，該航空公司在短暫使用其他供應商後，將重新與巴西航空工業合作。巴西航空工業表示，這項計畫旨在協助航空公司擴大營運時提升飛機可用率。

en.title: Embraer signs E-Jet fleet support agreement with TAP’s Portugália Airlines
en.summary: Embraer signs E-Jet support agreement with Portugália Airlines for 19 aircraft.
body: Embraer has signed a Component Pool Program agreement with TAP’s Portugália Airlines to support the carrier’s regional fleet of 19 E-Jet aircraft. The agreement covers 12 E-190s and seven E-195s. Embraer said the program will provide support for more than 300 components across multiple E-Jet systems, including advanced exchange services and repair and overhaul solutions.

Portugália Airlines Managing Director Mário Lobato de Faria said on October 15, 2026, that the airline was returning to Embraer after a “brief experience with an alternative supplier.” Embraer said the program is intended to help optimize aircraft availability as the airline expands its operations.

zh.title: 漢莎航空選定東京 首架空中巴士A350-1000預定12月首航
zh.summary: 漢莎航空預定12月3日以首架A350-1000飛抵東京羽田機場（HND）
body: 漢莎航空選定東京作為旗下首架空中巴士A350-1000寬體客機的商業首航目的地。漢莎航空於2026年10月15日宣佈，15架A350-1000中的首架預定於2026年12月3日自慕尼黑出發，飛抵東京羽田機場（HND）。
這架飛機目前位於法國圖盧茲的空中巴士廠區，預定於2026年11月中旬交付。漢莎航空表示，東京首航後數週內，上海與新加坡也將加入目的地網絡。
漢莎航空表示，航班將配置Allegris客艙，並由A350-1000與A350-900交替執飛。

en.title: Lufthansa selects Tokyo for December debut of its first Airbus A350-1000
en.summary: Lufthansa plans to send its first A350-1000 from Munich to Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND) on December 3.
body: Lufthansa has selected Tokyo as the destination for the first commercial flight of its first Airbus A350-1000 widebody. The airline announced on October 15, 2026, that the first of 15 A350-1000s is scheduled to depart Munich on December 3, 2026, and arrive at Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND).

The aircraft is currently at the Airbus facility in Toulouse, France, and is scheduled for delivery in mid-November 2026. Lufthansa said Shanghai and Singapore will be added to its destination portfolio in the weeks after the Tokyo launch.
Lufthansa said the flights will feature its Allegris cabin and will be operated alternately by the A350-1000 and A350-900.
